answer: A payout is split thus 48% arrives at settlement and the rest over 18 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The quartz schedule is applied in comet and wander shows each instalment. An adversary thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2200 identities would post 1007 proofs and burn roughly 31 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
